Rules: This history is only for legacy interpretation. It does not version native plugin identities or the modern savepoint contract.
Revision keys are full Git commit IDs within each plugin. Serialized Version fields are historical data, not unique revision identifiers.
Observed records prove a layout existed at a commit. Introduced records identify a reviewed layout-changing commit. Neither an author date nor a commit date is implicitly a release date.

ParentRevision links known layout ancestry within one plugin. Null means ancestry is not yet catalogued, not that no older layout existed. Never order revisions by timestamp or combine divergent Git branches.
Definition references select complete layouts from the baseline. Inline Fields are complete alternate layouts using the baseline Types and Rules. Do not mix fields from different revisions.
FieldChanges describes the difference for review and provenance; it is not an executable patch. Stable fields have no independent version counter.
Historical port changes and defects are retained as notes. Decoding a layout does not imply runtime support for its plugin.

Unknown or ambiguous layout selection stops decoding that positional record, with diagnostics, preceding items and an opaque remainder retained. A bare file version or plugin version does not identify a Git commit.

This catalogue is incremental. Missing commits or revisions are not evidence of compatibility. The baseline archive remains the release authority; recovered Git metadata is preserved as recorded without author-alias substitution.
